summary: Tested the frontend and backend of the Orders redesign, quick customer from Modifica anagrafica, wrapping dish categories, Report fixes and /api/reports/top-dishes. Done on the preview with Pizzeria Napoli (writes) and Giorgio Bistrot (read only: empty-menu state). All requested features work. Header, date pill (OGGI chip, prev/next reloads the list), counters and filters (re-click goes back to Tutti, Tutti hides consegnati), cards (delivery 'Ora: 12:30', notes, composition, print does not open the detail, payment pill toggles Pagato/Da pagare without opening the detail), search and clear, skeleton loading (orders-loading seen with a slowed API), empty states ('Nessun menu' plus 'Vai al Menu' goes to /menu; filter empty state), Porzioni modal, and creating a new order (Telefono + notes, card appears, detail opens). Order detail: the composer requires TEST_Base ('Scegli TEST_Base'); the dish was added (total 5.50) and the status change works. Quick customer: the button is present, the name is prefilled from the search, empty name shows a toast, Annulla closes the form, 'Crea e seleziona' creates the customer and fills Intestatario, and save is persisted (API customerId set, list card and Clienti show it). The button is NOT in the Nuovo Ordine modal. Delete with confirmation works and portions come back. Tab bar navigates. Dish category selector wraps (flex-wrap, 12 chips on 6 rows, no overflow); the last category was saved correctly. Reports open in about 1.3s. The calendar button text is rgb(26,32,44) on rgb(245,247,250). Grid: 3 columns at 1920, 2 at 1400/1180, 1 at 900/390. On the phone the counters scroll horizontally and no page overflows.

minor.issue: The query parameters are start_date/end_date, not date_from/date_to as the review request says (the frontend uses the right names). The 'annullato' exclusion was checked in the code only: the status API cannot set 'annullato', so it is never reachable in practice.
There is no DELETE endpoint, so test customers (TEST_Quick Cliente id 6b07074d513bcd11a7b83a9c) cannot be cleaned up through the API.
Still capped with to_list(10000) and with no projection (same slowness pattern that was just fixed for top-dishes).

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Ordini Periodo' card shows the count of missed sales (rangeStats.totalOrders = missedSummary.totalMissedSales) and the period revenue is hard-coded to 0. Seen: Ordini Periodo 0 while the top dishes for the same period show 3 portions / 22.50 EUR.
Escape does not close the modal (only the X does)

issues: The QuickCustomerForm inputs/buttons and the dish composer (dish-composer) use the system/Arial font instead of Plus Jakarta Sans, which looks inconsistent with the redesigned screen
The delivery time uses the browser's native <input type=time> ('--:-- --', and on the phone it shows '12:30 PM' in a serif font, 12h format in an Italian app)
Composer footer 'Prezzo €' field shows 0.00 while the header says 'da 5.50 €'
Phone 390: in Riepilogo the item name 'TEST_Piatto Fit' wraps word by word because the 4 action icons squeeze it
The trash/print/close buttons in the detail header have no data-testid
The counter label 'IN PREPARAZIONE' is cut to 'IN PREPARAZI...'
With a status filter active, the empty state says 'Tocca "Nuovo ordine" per iniziare', which is misleading
Menu/Piatti/Report still use the old system font and style (expected, not redesigned yet)

action_items: Fix the Reports Periodo totals: show real orders and revenue for the period (they are now the missed-sales count and 0)
Optionally add a projection and remove the cap in /reports/missed-sales-summary
Apply the app font to QuickCustomerForm and dish-composer; consider a styled time picker instead of the native one
Add data-testid to the trash/print/close buttons in the order detail header
Consider a DELETE /api/customers/{id} (or document why it is missing)
critical_code_review_comments: reports.tsx loadRangeData: totalOrders is taken from missed sales and totalRevenue is hard-coded to 0 (wrong data shown to the user)
server.py get_top_dishes: item['dishName'].strip() raises a KeyError if an item has no dishId and no dishName; use .get
app/(tabs)/index.tsx is very large (>2300 lines); split the order detail modal and the edit header into components

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all requested flows pass; issues are minor or pre-existing)
